home.title: Find a life partner with trust and respect
home.subtitle: A marriage-focused matrimony service for Tamil families in Tamil Nadu. Create a profile, discover compatible matches and talk safely — completely free.

pillars.freeBody: Search, interests and messaging are free for every member. No paid boosts, no hidden ranking.
pillars.safeBody: Your phone number, exact birth date and documents stay private. You decide who sees your photos.
pillars.verifiedBody: Every profile is reviewed before it appears. Badges say exactly what was checked.
pillars.familyBody: Parents can help manage a profile — only with the consent of the person getting married.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageBody: Choose how VAIBHAV appears to you. Tanglish is Tamil written in English letters.
settings.sessionsBody: Log out of devices you don't recognise.

about.title: About VAIBHAV
about.body: VAIBHAV is a free, marriage-oriented matrimony platform for Tamil families. We focus on respectful introductions, transparent matching and strong privacy controls.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.body: Register with your mobile number, complete your profile, set partner preferences and discover matches. When both of you accept an interest, you can chat safely inside VAIBHAV.

safety.title: Safety centre
safety.body: Never send money to anyone you meet online. Never share your OTP. Report anyone who pressures you to move off the platform or asks for money. You can block and report any profile at any time.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.body: Is VAIBHAV free? Yes — registration, search, interests and messaging are free for every member.
